#!/usr/bin/env sh
set -eu

# Start a netcat listener on a high, non-privileged port as a lightweight
# "health check heart-beat" for monitoring the container.
PORT="${PORT:-54321}"
HOST="${HOST:-0.0.0.0}"

start_listener() {
  # Prefer OpenBSD netcat flags; fall back to common alternatives.
  if nc -h 2>&1 | grep -qi "openbsd"; then
    nc -lk "$HOST" "$PORT"
  else
    nc -l -k -p "$PORT" -s "$HOST"
  fi
}

# Run listener in the background so the main application can still start.
start_listener &

# If command args were provided, run them as the main app.
# Otherwise, keep the container alive.
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
  exec "$@"
else
  wait
fi
